name: VXI Global Solutions
desc:
Remote Inbound Customer Service Specialist | $17.31/hr + performance incentives | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: VXI
Industry: Business Process Outsourcing / Customer Experience Services
What Your Day Will Look Like:
You'd be answering inbound calls helping customers with all kinds of questions, orders, billing, accounts, or general product and service concerns. This isn't a purely scripted role, you'd be listening closely to figure out what someone actually needs, asking good follow-up questions, and using judgment to find the best solution rather than reading off a card. Some calls are simple, others involve a frustrated customer who needs you to stay calm and steady while working toward a resolution. It's a genuine relationship-building role wrapped in customer service, where taking ownership of the conversation matters as much as knowing the answer.
assessment: Yes. The hiring process for this role is significantly more involved than a standard interview. Applicants join a Zoom session lasting approximately four hours that includes an on-camera assessment, breakout room interviews, an internet speed test, and background paperwork collection. Participants should block out a full half-day and have a quiet, stable internet connection before entering the process.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not specified in the posting
Required Experience: None strictly required
Preferred Experience: Customer service, call center, retail, hospitality, or another customer-facing background
Required Skills:
Strong verbal and written communication
Strong active listening and effective questioning skills
Critical thinking and problem-solving ability
Comfort navigating multiple software tools and systems simultaneously
Ability to remain composed and professional during frustrating or emotionally charged conversations
Strong time management, reliability, and remote work discipline
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with customer-facing experience, whether from retail, hospitality, or a call center, who wants to grow those skills further
Someone who genuinely enjoys building rapport and making customers feel heard, not just processing transactions
Someone comfortable being coached regularly and applying feedback quickly
Someone who can multitask across systems while keeping a natural, personalized conversation going
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone who prefers a purely scripted role with less independent judgment involved
Anyone who struggles with frequent coaching and performance-based feedback
Anyone who needs a highly predictable, low-change work environment, since this role involves frequent process and product updates
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Inbound customer service
Active listening
Critical thinking and problem-solving
Customer de-escalation
Multi-system navigation
Relationship building
Call center experience
Coaching and performance improvement
Remote work discipline
Customer ownership
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about a time you had to figure out what a customer really needed, even though they didn't explain it clearly at first.
Walk us through how you'd handle a frustrated customer while still moving the conversation toward a solution.
How do you respond when you receive coaching or feedback on your performance?
What's your comfort level navigating multiple systems or tools while staying focused on the customer conversation?
Describe a time you had to adapt quickly to a new process, product, or policy change.
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $17.31 per hour, with opportunities for performance-based incentives
Shift: Not specified in the posting
Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options, paid training, and a Referral for Life program offering ongoing referral bonuses
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: Case by Case
Drug Test: Not usually
Notes: This is a solid opportunity for a participant who wants to build genuine customer service and critical-thinking skills beyond a scripted role, with real coaching and career growth built into the culture. The role emphasizes ownership and relationship-building over quick transactional handling, which is a nice selling point for someone who takes pride in doing more than the bare minimum on a call.
Career Pathway: Remote Inbound Customer Service Specialist → Senior Customer Service Specialist → Team Lead or Quality Assurance Specialist
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
